title: Certificate verification
description: Confirm the authenticity of an issued certificate.
validDescription: This certificate was issued by {company} and is currently valid.
revokedDescription: This certificate was issued by {company} but has since been revoked and is no longer valid.
notFoundDescription: No certificate matches this number. Check the number printed on the certificate and try again.
codeRequiredDescription: This certificate is on record with {company}. To see the holder's name, certificate type and issue date, enter the verification code printed next to the QR code on the certificate.
codeMismatchDescription: The code you entered does not match this certificate. Check the verification code printed next to the QR code and try again.

lookup.title: Verify another certificate
lookup.label: Certificate number
lookup.codeHint: Printed next to the QR code on the certificate.

privacyNote: For privacy, this page shows only the details needed to confirm authenticity.
